Manage signed webhook endpoints, delivery history, and signature verification.

## `WebhooksClient`

Project webhook endpoints, secret rotation, and delivery history.

### `create`

Creates a signed webhook endpoint and reveals its secret once.

```ts no-check
create(options: CreateWebhookEndpointOptions): Promise<CreatedWebhookEndpoint>
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | <code>CreateWebhookEndpointOptions</code> | Yes | HTTPS destination, subscribed event types, and initial active state. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;CreatedWebhookEndpoint&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when validation, authentication, or executor admission fails.

**Example**

```ts
import { Eyeball } from "@eyeball/sdk";

const eyeball = new Eyeball({
  apiKey: process.env.EYEBALL_API_KEY!,
  baseUrl: process.env.EYEBALL_EXECUTOR_URL!,
});

const endpoint = await eyeball.webhooks.create({
  url: "https://agent.example.com/eyeball",
  events: ["execution.completed", "trigger.slack.message_received"],
});
console.log(endpoint.secret);
```

### `delete`

Permanently removes one webhook endpoint.

```ts no-check

```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpointId` | <code>string</code> | Yes | Project-scoped webhook endpoint identifier. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;void&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when the endpoint is unavailable or the request fails.

### `deliveries`

Lists delivery attempts for one webhook endpoint.

```ts no-check

```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpointId` | <code>string</code> | Yes | Project-scoped webhook endpoint identifier. |
| `options` | <code>ListWebhookDeliveriesOptions</code> | No | Cursor and page-size controls. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;WebhookDeliveryPage&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when pagination is invalid or the executor request fails.

### `rotateSecret`

Invalidates the prior signing secret and reveals its replacement once.

```ts no-check

```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpointId` | <code>string</code> | Yes | Project-scoped webhook endpoint identifier. |

**Returns:** <code>Promise&lt;RotatedWebhookSecret&gt;</code>

**Throws**

- EyeballError when the endpoint is unavailable or the request fails.

**Throws**

## `createWebhookSignature`

Creates the RFC 001 `v1=<hex>` signature for an exact raw payload.

```ts no-check
createWebhookSignature(options: CreateWebhookSignatureOptions): string
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | <code>CreateWebhookSignatureOptions</code> | Yes | — |

**Returns:** <code>string</code>

## `verifyWebhookSignature`

Verifies a signed webhook using a constant-time digest comparison and a
five-minute replay window. The payload must be the unmodified raw body.

```ts no-check
verifyWebhookSignature(options: VerifyWebhookSignatureOptions): boolean
```

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `options` | <code>VerifyWebhookSignatureOptions</code> | Yes | — |

**Returns:** <code>boolean</code>
